content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity) at § 10.3(A) / p0183.**

- **Responsive clause:** § 10.3(A) requires Customer, "during the Term," to obtain from M&I *all* Services included in the Monthly Base Fee — a sole-source lock for the full eight-year Term (§ 1.X), with no descope right and no exit on M&I's performance failures.
- **Other "exclusive" hits checked and cleared:** § 17.1 (our data ownership), § 21.7(A), § 22 venue, § 23 licence grant, § 10.4 — none bind Customer's sourcing; § 21.10 only sweeps in Affiliate processing "which M&I does". §§ 3.1–3.2 confirm the asymmetry (M&I may use Affiliates and third parties).
- **Classification:** fails fallback on duration (8 years vs 12 months) and on both automatic performance-based exits (service levels, delivery dates); § 9 credits and § 12 default remedies are not automatic exclusivity terminations.
- **Cure (preferred, single operation, minimality gate passed):** the sourcing requirement sentence is replaced with express freedom to obtain those Services from M&I or any other provider and a statement that Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation; the Schedule 6.2 reference and the pricing acknowledgment are preserved verbatim, and the fallback is offered in the comment.
